title: Grotesque Dance
identity: Ivan Shishov, Grotesque Dance from The Master Barber, in an alto saxophone and piano edition, Edition Musicus EM157AS. A separate bassoon-and-piano arrangement by Felix Clyde exists; the sax edition’s arranger/provenance remains unresolved.

evidence.claim: A saxophone repertoire list identifies the E-flat saxophone and piano edition as Grotesque Dance from The Master Barber.
The Illinois Grade School Music Association lists the related title as a Class B alto saxophone solo, credited Shishov/Felix and Edition Musicus.
IMSLP worklist result identifies a Felix Clyde bassoon-and-piano arrangement of the opera excerpt.

collection_flag: An opera excerpt adapted for saxophone. A school solo-list appearance is documented, but does not establish simplification or college exclusion.
gaps: Saxophone edition score and its arranger attribution were not inspected; do not assume the bassoon arrangement is the saxophone edition.
